author: blu
body: Proves Time Walk: an extra turn. "Take an extra turn after this one." compiles to the ExtraTurn effect, whose resolution sets the game's extra-turn flag; the turn loop then runs another full turn for the caster. Here player 0 opens with two Islands and a Time Walk: it casts and resolves the Time Walk, so it takes TWO turns in a row -- move-count advances by 2, versus 1 for an ordinary turn. The flag is set only on resolution, so a countered Time Walk grants nothing.
